brief.t: P zero fire first. The CRM is fully locked out — every login and the API key return unauthorized after the developer's Monday deploy. I already escalated in the ticket thread demanding restore. Nobody on the team can reach tasks or quotes until this is fixed.

Two calls on your calendar. Doris intro at noon Eastern, and Drake True Revival branding meeting at two Eastern on Google Meet.

Victor Armendarez, still the number one quick win. Eighty seven percent close, four thousand total units, overdue since July tenth. CRM chat is down, so text or call Ronald directly for the raw cost on Curl Cream and Edge Gel. One number and I quote same day.

kb.a: The CRM is fully locked out as of Wednesday morning July fifteenth. Every user login and the agent API key return unauthorized. Root cause suspicion is the developer's July thirteenth REST API deploy wiped or re-hashed the users table. The agent escalated it as P zero in the ticket thread demanding full restore, a working key, and root cause. Awaiting developer response.

Tiffany landed from her flight Tuesday night and is available Wednesday only before leaving on safari. She agreed to a call and a manufacturing price quote — reference product is the Medicube Rosemary P D R N hair set. James owes her the quote conversation. Time critical today.
Doris intro call is Wednesday July fifteenth, noon to one Eastern. Aaron accepted the invite.

Drake True Revival branding meeting is Wednesday July fifteenth, two to three Eastern on Google Meet. Drake already paid the twenty eight hundred dollar R and D fee. The corrected agreement still needs to go to Drake by email and to Laura — Sam owes Drake's email address.

Victor Armendarez, eighty seven percent close, Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel, two thousand units each in six ounce jars, seventy five percent margin, NDA signed. Pricing overdue since July tenth and the daily briefing calls it the number one quick win. Blocked on Ronald's raw cost per unit — with CRM chat down, text or call Ronald directly.

Diana Aviles of ELOIRE needs dry shampoo reorder quotes for five hundred and one thousand units — due this week, CRM task went overdue July fourteenth. She also flagged bottle scratching and spotting concerns from the last run. Open questions: does Ronald have the B O M, what packaging, and margin sixty five or seventy five.

Raul Guardado at STRUCK wants a call this week covering the pending C P T test, peptide C O As, the one hundred fifty mil derm sample, and the final ship date for five hundred to one thousand units. The interim seven day P C T passed. Laura sent box art for review and the revised project scope for signing.
Tyler Murray, a buy side analyst at Calder Capital, is following up again on the unsigned NDA with Sam. Second chase. Sam needs to decide sign or decline.

ALOETALLOW has a three part fulfillment mess. Order fifteen thirty three came back return to sender and is being held. Order sixteen thirty four had six bottles never scanned and the label is being voided and reprinted. And a customer emailed an address change on an order that already shipped. Unresolved as of Tuesday night.
Uberto of MEN STUFF needs the production schedule confirmed. Product must be in Florida by August twentieth for a September first launch. He at-mentioned Sam on WhatsApp.

Laura's open asks via the Sam and Aidan chat: add Roon to the production schedule, compose a project turn down today, order sharpies and printer ink, get the wall size for the P L L logo at the new facility, and door vinyl with name hours and phone.
James Bailey of Morning Glory: Laura sent the revised scope and estimate for signing Tuesday with Sam and Aidan copied. Awaiting his signature. He is ready to close.

Maria Robles of Robles BioCeutics, new inbound July thirteenth, pre launch skincare line asking about M O Q, customization, packaging, timeline, and compliance. Recommended reply is a capabilities overview plus a discovery call invite.

Ben Kar from Tavro, ninety percent close, thirty thousand units custom tallow plus argan oil skincare. Fourteen days silent since the June thirtieth call and no proposal ever sent. The agent drafts the proposal, Sam reviews, then it goes out once by WhatsApp and email.
Phoebe Mroczek, eighty percent close, men's grooming tallow balm one to two and a half thousand units. Forty eight days silent — re-engage and ask about the Tampa sample.
Amy Saylor at HealthSource Chiropractic, seventy eight percent, recovery roll on topical for nationwide chiro offices, five thousand units. Forty one days silent — needs a post call check in.
Sky and Sol: Max replied Tuesday that they are currently trying the sample. Testing in progress — follow up loop is closed for now, check back next week.
ASSEA with Apostolia. Ronald answered the refrigeration and shipping precautions. Still need to relay that to Apostolia on WhatsApp, plus the NDA and H S code docs are outstanding.
Aran Beauty wants Vanilla, Jasmine, Rose, and Sweet Orange scent samples. Ronald was nudged July ninth. His reply is unknown because the CRM team chat is locked out.

Terra Lotus. Kenna added thirty thousand units of face cleanser in tubes plus shampoo conditioner and body wash samples. Aidan's task still does not reflect it, and the CRM is currently locked out anyway. Pending Sam's confirm plus CRM restore.
Pure Good. Quote Q double oh two eight at three hundred twenty nine thousand dollars is blocked because Kenna gatekeeps all communication. Aidan's pricing task is a week overdue.

Aidan Kraim's Kenna Atlas quote, Pure Good pricing, and Terra Lotus tasks are now seven days overdue from July eighth. Verification is blocked by the CRM lockout, and once it is restored he gets a formal nudge.
Ronald the chemist owes the Victor Armendarez raw costs for Curl Cream and Edge Gel, and the Aran Beauty scent sample timeline. With CRM chat down, reach him by text or phone.

Elmar Nasibov pricing for Hydrating Mist, Peptide Cream, and Hydrating Serum. Ronald's raw costs are in hand. Still blocked on Sam's margin call, seventy five or sixty five, plus packaging and labor rates. No overnight WhatsApp activity from Elmar.

Standard margin is sixty five percent. Sam specified seventy five for Victor. Still unconfirmed whether seventy five is the new company standard. Fill labor and overhead rates are still not documented anywhere in the CRM.

Facility move status. Zoning is cleared but change of occupancy from office to manufacturing is the key permit risk. New issue: the building has no sprinkler or fire system — the escape hatch is keeping the manufacturing fire area under twelve thousand square feet with rated fire barriers, and Sam owes the total square footage and whether any product is aerosol. Jeff Cook confirmed the mover order, and DTE Energy needs job requirement info for electrical service at the new building. The polished layout plan version one is done with Sam's four changes on it.
